name: go-ledger
description: Task runner for the Go API and the React console. npm scripts rather than a Makefile, because make is not installed on Windows by default and Node already is. No dependencies of its own: every script shells out to go, docker or web/, so there is nothing to install here. Run dev:api and dev:web in two terminals.

scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && go build -tags embed_spa -o bin/server ./cmd/server
scripts.test: go test ./... && npm --prefix web run test
